[P2] Approach: satisfy rule 4 for warning and Glue branches

The tool blocking returns now have behavioral coverage, but neither new settings-warning branch has a behavioral test. `getTableLocation` is also mocked without tests distinguishing a missing table from other Glue errors. Removing the warnings or changing that error handling would leave these behaviors unguarded; the description explicitly acknowledges the omissions. This breaks CONTRIBUTING rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and agree on observable acceptance coverage for the checks and warnings before revising the implementation.
